data.name: Jaquith
data.gender_notes: Jaquith is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Iacobus, derived from Hebrew 'Ya'akov' which means 'may God protect'. Jaquith embodies the strength and power of God, invoking protection and courage. The name Jaquith carries the meaning “God's power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jaquith usually hope their child will grow to embody god's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jaquith belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaquith total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: יעקית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יעקית הוא נגזר מהשם העברי יעקב, שפירושו 'תחליף אלוהים' או 'יעקב אלוהים'. השם יעקב מוזכר במקרא כבנו של יצחק ואביו של יוסף ויהודה. השם יעקית הוא שינוי של השם יעקב, והוא משמש כשם פרטי וגם כשם משפחה.

in_greek.name: Ιακείθ
in_greek.meaning: Αντί του Θεού, Ιακώβ του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιακείθ είναι παράγωγο του εβραϊκού ονόματος Ιακώβ, που σημαίνει 'Αντί του Θεού' ή 'Ιακώβ του Θεού'. Το όνομα Ιακώβ αναφέρεται στην Αγία Γραφή ως ο γιος του Ισαάκ και πατέρας του Ιωσήφ και του Ιούδα. Το όνομα Ιακείθ είναι μια παραλλαγή του ονόματος Ιακώβ και χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωπικό όνομα και ως επώνυμο.

in_latin.name: Jaquith
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jaquith derivatur ex nomine hebraico Jacob, quod significat 'Deus substituit' vel 'Jacobus Dei'. Nomen Jacob in Biblia memoratur ut filius Isaac et pater Joseph et Juda. Nomen Jaquith est variatio nominis Jacob et adhibetur ut nomen personale et etiam ut nomen familiae.

in_english.name: Jaquith
in_english.meaning: God replaces, supplanter, or God is gracious
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jaquith is derived from the Hebrew name Jacob, which means 'God replaces,' 'supplanter,' or 'God is gracious.' The name Jacob appears in the Bible as the son of Isaac and the father of Joseph and Judah. Jaquith is a variation of the name Jacob and is used as a given name and surname in Christian traditions. It symbolizes divine providence and grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaquith is of old and noble origin, originating from the Latin name Iacobus, which was borne by the Biblical figure Saint James, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. This name was popular among the European nobility, including the Normans who brought it to England and Ireland, where it gained a strong cultural significance. It has been carried down through generations and remains a name of esteem and proud heritage.
